screen.alkahest.journal.page.0:
My first notes

I shall begin with a cauldron, water and fire. On the map I can trace how my thoughts connect. I drag the background, select a node and scroll long notes with the wheel.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.1:
My cauldron

I need a cauldron, four copper ingots at the sides and three stones below. Under it I can place a lit campfire, fire, lava or magma, then fill it with a water bucket.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.2:
Cauldron brewing

Items thrown into a heated cauldron with water always only dissolve into essences (even if the item is also a recipe catalyst). Items can also be dissolved with right-click (sneak-use dissolves a full stack), while catalysts for recipes and hypotheses trigger ONLY on right-click once the required essences are present. An empty hand checks dissolved essences, and an Aqua wand fills the cauldron for one charge. Clean heated water with no essences boils down to salt after 20 seconds.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.3:
Essence recipes

Bottle + 1 Aqua + 2 Ignis = purified water.
Wheat seeds + 4 Herba + 2 Aqua = 2 herbal paste.
Gunpowder + 3 Ignis + 3 Potentia = 2 fire dust.
Slimeball + 3 Vitium + 3 Herba = 2 caustic slime.
String + 3 Ordo + 1 Aqua = 2 binding salt.

Salt and flint make crystallization dust. Thrown in or used on the cauldron, it precipitates leftover essences into 5% stability crystals.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.4:
Distillation

I need six copper ingots, two glass blocks and a furnace for the distillery. Use opens its interface: I put a stack of known organic matter into the input. It processes one item per minute while there is room for the result.

I obtain only primal essences: compounds in the input resolve to their primal components. Sometimes I get ash instead.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.5:
Reagents

If I right-click slime with fire dust in my inventory, I get napalm; caustic slime and gunpowder make an acid bomb. I can throw them, but I should be careful: they can hurt me too.

Lightning rod + 4 Ignis + 4 Aer + 2 Potentia = lightning in a bottle. Fermented spider eye + 4 Mortuus + 3 Vitium + 2 Aqua = miasma. Lightning is real and can start fires; miasma poisons and corrodes armor, including mine.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.6:
Essences and monocle

For a monocle I dissolve 3 Ordo and 2 Lux in a heated cauldron with water and apply a glass pane by right-clicking the cauldron. If the sight hypothesis is active, the first glass pane with dissolved Ordo completes the experiment. Equipped, it shows item essences. A stick and primal crystal make a wand.

I can craft a jar from seven glass panes in a U shape. I place it and use a crystal on it: for now one crystal gives one unit. Each jar holds just one essence type. I can pour matching types together; excess above 100 evaporates.

Three copper ingots, glass and a Potentia crystal make a charger. I combine Ignis and Ordo crystals in a crafting grid to make Potentia. I can combine parent crystals for other compound essences too; the resulting crystal is unstable. I place the charger on a jar: it automatically draws the matching essence and restores up to ten charges per unit each second while I am nearby.

Glass, copper and an Aer crystal make eight pipes; I can distil Aer from raw chicken. I connect two jars with pipes. I use a wand to set each output, sneak-use to set a filter and an empty hand to inspect settings.

I can make a manual separator from three copper ingots, glass, quartz and an Ordo crystal. If I have an old mixed jar, I insert it and use empty jars to extract one essence type at a time. An empty hand returns the original jar. Stability is unchanged.

With my monocle equipped, looking at a jar reveals its exact contents; looking at a pipe reveals its direction and filter. Sneak-using a stack of crystals fills a compatible jar up to its limit and leaves any excess with me.

Looking at a cauldron with my monocle also shows its dissolved essences.
